limitations: Bounded two-round review: PCS/ISR/RES/TEC/OPT conditional60; MED conditional40; GSS/LON unresolved. All31 subpillars reviewed, not all measured.75% scored weight contributes42; missing25% gives42–67 conditional arithmetic range, not an exclusion bound or forecast. dimensions.rationale: Actual stormwater construction and maintained walking/cycling routes support protection; cold/ice, rain and source-water effects remain material. Low heat/seismic screening values are context, not current complete protection.
dimensions.assumption: Reviewed urban maintenance and stormwater measures usually protect ordinary residents and apply reasonably to FUA239 at cutoff. Unreviewed coastal, geophysical and heat scenarios are not assumed absent; rejecting this protection/representativeness inference restores unknown.

dimensions.rationale: National Finnish threat context, institutional cyber response and preparedness do not establish the local organized-violence/strategic-impact and mitigation bridge. Individual stabbing leads are not assumed organized violence or proof of city-wide safety.
dimensions.assumption: No whole-dimension score is asserted; real local threat, resident/channel consequences and actual mitigation plus applicability assumptions are the minimum missing bridge, not a perfect population-wide incident rate.

dimensions.rationale: Completed participatory-budget projects, service changes, digital assistance and food distribution demonstrate execution; fiscal and staffing pressure, delayed interfaces and inaccessible assisted authorization remain constraints.
dimensions.assumption: Actual execution and delivered alternatives reasonably support major usual services and resident reach in FUA239 and persist to cutoff; fiscal/group-access and recovery weaknesses remain material. Rejecting applicability requires reassessment, not automatic retention of60.

dimensions.rationale: Actual treated-water results, energy production/electric-boiler deployment and food redistribution support normal supply; common river/electricity dependence, backup-water litigation and household cost pressure remain.
dimensions.assumption: Core and related operator delivery generally reaches FUA239 and essential water/energy/food are ordinarily affordable at local median income. Aid counts are not a universal affordability measure; future reserve-water/battery projects are not assumed operational.

dimensions.rationale: Treatment waits improved to46 of9737 over six months by2026Apr30, with new hospital/staff, purchasing and referral mitigation. Resources diverted from need assessment left3183/26.5% over three months inApr2026; audit identifies a continuing necessary-care bottleneck. Public fees do not erase waits.
dimensions.assumption: The regionally documented need-assessment bottleneck reasonably applies to Oulu residents and remains important after available mitigation at cutoff. If actual current alternatives normally provide timely assessment and appropriate necessary care, reconsider60; rejecting this residual/spatial/continuity interpretation leaves MED unknown, not automatically40.

dimensions.rationale: No verified local human-implementation, compliant current adoption and appropriate usual-resident payer/monitoring bridge was obtained in two targeted rounds. Helsinki FINGER and other-city CAR-T cannot be inherited by institution name or Finnish nationality.
dimensions.assumption: No score is assigned. A local actual disease-specific delivery route with credible human/regulatory support and eligibility, net burden and monitoring would discriminate40/60; unknown is not evidence of a real access failure or absence of capability.

dimensions.rationale: University invention/PoC and historical company creation connect with actual municipal, hospital and industrial testing/deployment and52,798 bot interactions; business participation constraints and lack of assisted authorization persist despite delivered digital support. Patents/tests do not equal sales.
dimensions.assumption: Reviewed multi-producer production and actual deployments reasonably represent usual industries and residents at cutoff. SME participation and authentication barriers remain material after hundreds reached by support; if strong capability and mitigation make residuals minor,80 is admissible rather than capped by unmeasured high-tier facts.

dimensions.rationale: Actual regional rail/bus and international airport activity, EU worker-residence rights and accrued earnings-pension abroad provide channels. Cancelled international routes, lower landings, capacity and common failures remain constraints; a planned2026 Riga opening is not actual service.
dimensions.assumption: Ordinary residents can usually reach usable international connections via operating airport/rail links and external Finnish hubs and afford travel/relocation/account use. National flight statistics do not prove local routes; household communication and pension/asset scope remain limited and necessary usability/continuity assumptions are retractable.
